clipped_counts_are: PER FRAME in DetectorResult; the sweep CSV aggregates over all realisations at a level
negative_read_noise_samples: read noise is additive Gaussian and CAN go negative; negatives are clipped to 0 by np.clip(e,0,full_well) before ADC, so the floor is hard at 0 ADU
operating_point_established_by: scan over photons x gain on a FLAT wavefront, then corrected using ABERRATED frames (signal_sweep.csv) which clip earlier
zero_clipping_scope: observed over the tested wavefronts and amplitudes; NOT a guarantee for every possible aberration -- a sufficiently concentrated spot pattern can clip at any fixed gain
